name: level-ldtk
description: Load LDtk-exported levels (tiles + entities) into the spawn pipeline
postInstallNotes:
## level-ldtk installed

Export your LDtk project to a `.ldtk` file under `Content/`, then add it to your `.mgcb`:
```
#begin Levels/your_project.ldtk
/importer:LDtkImporter
/processor:LDtkProcessor
/build:Levels/your_project.ldtk
```

Reference the LDtkMonogame content pipeline DLL in your csproj's `MonoGameMGCBAdditionalArguments`:
```
<MonoGameMGCBAdditionalArguments>$(MonoGameMGCBAdditionalArguments) /reference:$(NuGetPackageRoot)ldtkmonogame.contentpipeline/1.8.0/lib/net8.0/LDtk.ContentPipeline.dll</MonoGameMGCBAdditionalArguments>
```

At runtime, add both parsers to your pipeline AFTER `LevelLoadRequestSystem`:
```csharp
new LDtkTileParserSystem(world, content, ...)
new LDtkEntityParserSystem(world, ...)
```

**Premises:** `docs/level-loading/premises.md`
